senses.gloss:
अहन, अस्, आ, अम्, illuminating, spreading light
(epithet of the dawn).
अहन अहन. See 2. अह्.

अह अह, ind. (as a particle implying
ascertainment, affirmation, certainty, &c.) surely, cer-
tainly, yes, well; (as explaining, defining, admitting,
limiting, &c.) namely; I grant you, granted, indeed,
of course; at least. This particle is also said to im-
ply rejecting, sending; deviation from custom, im-
propriety.

आह 1. आह, ind. (an interjection implying
reproof, severity, command, casting, sending) Ah!
Aha! &c.
आह 2. आह. See rt. 3. अह्.
अहंयाति, अहंयु, &c. See under अहम्.
अहं-याति, इस्, m., N. of a son of Saṃyāti.

अहत अ-हत, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. हन्), unhurt,
uninjured, not struck, not killed; unbeaten (as clothes
in washing); unwashed, new; unblemished, un-
soiled; not disappointed; (अम्), n. unwashed or new
clothes.

आ-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, struck, beaten; injured, killed;
multiplied; known, understood; uttered falsely; (अस्),
m. a drum; (अम्), n. old cloth or raiment; new cloth
or clothes; assertion of an impossibility.
—आहत-
लक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, noted for good qualities.
अ-हति or अ-हन्ति, इस्, f., Ved. safeness.

आ-हति, इस्, f. hitting, striking, a blow, a hit;
killing.
अ-हत्वा, ind. not having killed.

अ-हननीय or अ-हन्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be
killed.

अ-हन्त्य or अ-हन्त्र or अ-हन्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. indestructible, invincible.

अहन् अहन् and अहस्, n. (said to be fr. 2.
हा with अ, ‘not;’ according to others, who compare
the Goth. daya, Germ. tag, Eng. day, a corruption
of दहन् fr. rt. दह्; the nom. acc. voc. sing. and
the middle cases come fr. अहस्, the others fr. अहन्;
in the Vedas the middle cases also are sometimes
formed fr. अहन्, e. g. अहभ्यस्, अहभिस्); a day;
a sacrificial or festival day; a day's work; a portion
of a book appointed for one day's reading; day per-
sonified as one of the eight Vasus; N. of a Tīrtha;
अहन्य्-अहनि or अहर्-अहः, day by day, daily;
अहनी, du. day and night; तद् अहस्, on that very
day; यद् अहस्, on which day. (As the last mem-
ber of a compound अहन् generally appears in the
form अह, m., rarely n., but sometimes also in the
form अहन्, e. g. पुण्याह, एकाहन्, q. v. As the
first member of a compound अहस् and अहर् are the
usual forms; as in the following examples.)
—अहः-
पति, इस्, m. lord of the day, the sun; see अहर्-
पति.
—अहः-शेष, अम्, n. evening.
—अहर्-आगम,
अस्, m. the approach of day.
—अहर्-गण, अस्, m. a
series of sacrificial days; a month; any calculated
term.
—अहर्-जर, अस्, m., Ved. the year (as making
days become old).
—अहर्-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
born in the day or from day, not belonging to night
or to the spirits of darkness.
—अहर्-दिव, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. existing every day; (अम्), ind. daily, day by day.
—अहर्-दिवि, ind., Ved. day by day, every day, con-
stantly.
—अहर्-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. beholding the day,
living.
—अहर्-निश, अम्, n. day and night, a whole
day; (अम्), ind. day and night, during the whole
day, continually.
—अहर्-पति, इस्, m., Ved. lord of the
day; the sun; epithet of Śiva; also written अहः-
पति.
—अहर्-बान्धव, अस्, m. the sun.
—अहर्-
भाज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. partaking of the day.
—अहर्-
मणि, इस्, m. the sun.
—अहर्-मुख, अम्, n. com-
mencement of the day, morning, dawn.
—अहर्-
लोक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. taking the place of day.
—अहर्-विद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. existing (many) days;
known long ago; knowing the (fit) time or season.
—अहश्-शस्, ind., Ved. every day.
—अहस्-कर,
अस्, m. the sun.
—अहस्-पति, इस्, m. the sun; swallow
wort.

अहन्; for ‘and अहस्’ read — अहर्, which is the
proper form of the Nominative.

आहन् आ-हन्, cl. 2. P. A. -हन्ति, -हते,
-हन्तुम्, to strike at, hit, beat, kill; commit
slaughter.

अहम् अहम्, nom. sing. ‘I.’ The supposed
base of this 1st personal pronoun is अस्मद्, q. v. [cf.
Zend azem; Gr. ἐγών, ἐγώ, ἱών; Lat. ego; Goth.
ik; Mod. Germ. ich; Lith. asz; Slav. az; Cambro-
brit. ym; Bret. am, em].

अहंयु, उस्, उस्, उ, selfish, proud, haughty; (उस्),
m. a warrior.

अहं-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speaking only of one's self,
presumptuous, haughty.

अहं-श्रेयस्, अस्, or अहं-श्रेयस, अम्, n. claim-
ing superiority for one's self.

अहं-सन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. gaining for one's
self, obtaining for one's self.

अहङ्-कर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be referred to self;
(अम्), n. the object of Ahaṅkāra.

अहङ्-कार, अस्, m. the making of self, sense of
self, thinking of self, egotism, individuality; self-con-
sciousness, pride, haughtiness; (in the Sāṅkhya phil.)
the third of the eight producers or elements of crea-
tion, viz. the conceit or conception of individuality,
individualization.
—अहङ्कार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, con-
scious, selfish, proud.
अहङ्-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, self-important, proud.

अहङ्-कार्य, अम्, n. that which is to be done by
one's self, any personal object, business or matter.

आहङ्कार्य आहङ्कार्य, अम्, n. (fr. अहङ्-कार),
conceitedness.

अहङ्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, egotistic; proud, haughty;
conscious.

अहङ्-कृति, इस्, f. egotism, high opinion of one's
self, pride.

अहम्-अग्रिका, f. or अहम्-उत्तर, अम्, n. a contest
for superiority, rivalry.

अहम्-अहमिका, f. assertion or conceit of superi-
ority, boasting, egotism; military vaunting.

अहम्-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desirous of being
first.

अहम्-पूर्विका, f. or अहम्-प्रथमिका, f. emu-
lative onset, the running forward of soldiers with
emulation; conceit, vaunting.

अहम्-भद्र, अम्, n. self-conceit, a high notion
of one's own superiority.

अहम्-मति, इस्, f. or अहम्-मान, अम्, n. self-
illusion, spiritual ignorance, conceit, self-love.

अहर अ-हर, अस्, m. (rt. हृ), N. of the
twelfth Manu; a Dānava.

आ-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of compounds)
bringing, fetching; (अस्), m. taking, seizing; accom-
plishing, offering of a sacrifice; drawing in breath,
inhaling, inhaled air; breath inspired, inspiration.

आ-हार, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, bringing near, procuring;
going to fetch; (अस्), m. taking, fetching, bringing
near; employing; taking food, food (e. g. आहारं
कृ, to take food, eat).
—आहार-विरह, अस्, m.
want of food.
—आहार-सम्भव, अस्, m. the juice
of the body, chyle, lymph, serum.
—आहारार्थिन्
(˚र-अर्˚), ई, इनी, इ, begging or seeking for food.
अ-हरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be taken away.
अ-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, not taking (?).

अ-हार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be stolen, not to be
removed; (अस्), m. a mountain.
—अहार्य-ता, f. or
अहार्य-त्व, अम्, n. the state of not being liable to
be taken away, security.
अहार्य अ-हार्य, &c. See under अ-हर.

आ-हार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken or seized; to be
fetched or brought near; to be extracted or removed;
what may be removed, adventitious, accessary, inci-
dental; to be eaten; (अस्), m. a kind of bandage;
(अम्), n. any disease to be treated by the operation of
extracting; extraction; a vessel; the ornamentative
part of the drama, the dress, decorations, &c.
—आहार्य-
शोभा, f. adventitious beauty, beauty not natural but
the effect of paints, ornaments, &c.
अहरित अ-हरित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not yellow.

अहर्ष अ-हर्ष, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. हृष्), un-
happy, gloomy, sorrowful.
अ-हर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, unhappy, sorrowful.

अहल अ-हल, अस्, आ, अम्, or अ-हलि, इस्, इस्, इ,
unploughed, unfurrowed.

अहल्लिक अहल्लिक, अस्, m., Ved. a talker,
tattler (?).

अहवनीय अ-हवनीय, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. हु),
not to be offered as an oblation, not fit or proper to
be sacrificed.

आ-हवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be offered as an obla-
tion; (अस्), m. a consecrated fire taken from the
householder's perpetual fire and prepared for receiving
oblations; the eastern of the three fires burning at
a sacrifice.

अ-हविस्, इस्, इस्, इस्, Ved. without oblations, sacri-
ficeless.
अहस्त अ-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, handless.

अहह अहह or अहहा, ind. a particle or
interjection, as Ah! Aha! &c., implying surprise,
fatigue, pain, sorrow, pleasure, calling.

अहावस् अहावस्, Ved., said to be a sound
like a flourish at the end of a hymn.

आहक आहक, अस्, m. a peculiar disease of
the nose, inflammation of the Schneiderian membrane.

आ-हनन, अम्, n. the act of striking at, beating;
killing of an animal.

आहनन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. making one's self
known by beating (a drum &c.).

आहनस् आहनस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (fr. rt. हन् ?),
Ved. swelling, tumid, crammed full; fat, luxuriant,
lascivious; (Sāy.) to be beaten or pressed out (as
Soma).

आहनस्य, अम्, n., Ved. luxuriancy, lasciviousness;
(आस्), f. pl. verses (ऋचस्) of a lascivious character.
—आहनस्य-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. uttering las-
civious words.

आहलक् आहलक्, ind., Ved. a smacking
sound.

आहव, आहवन, आह्व, &c. See under
आ-हु and आ-ह्वे.

1. आ-हव, अस्, m. sacrificing, sacrifice. (For 2.
आ-हव see under आ-ह्वे.)

2. आ-हव, अस्, m. challenge, provoking, calling;
war, battle.
—आहव-काम्या, f. desire of war: (for
1. आ-हव see under आ-हु, page 136, col. 3.)

1. आ-हाव, अस्, m., Ved. a trough, a pail, a vessel;
a trough near a well for watering cattle.
2. आ-हाव, अस्, m. calling, invoking; battle, war.

आ-हवन, अम्, n., Ved. offering an oblation,
offering sacrifice, sacrifice.

आहवनीयक, अस्, आ, अम्, fit for a burnt offering;
(अस्), m. a consecrated fire.

आ-हरण, अस्, आ, अम्, taking away, robbing; (अम्),
n. taking, seizing, bringing near; extracting, remov-
ing; accomplishing, offering at a sacrifice; causing,
inducing.

आहरणी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to give
as a present.

आ-हर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who takes, seizes, brings
or procures; inducing, causing; offering; (ता), m.
a copy holder (in law).
आ-हारक, अस्, आ, अम्, going to fetch.

आ-हारिक, (with Jainas) one of the five bodies
belonging to the soul; described by Colebrooke as a
minute form, issuing from the head of a meditative
sage to consult an omniscient saint and returning with
the desired information.
अहङ्-करण, अम्, n. = अहङ्-कार.
अहर्-दल, mid-day.
अहस्-त्रियाम, अम्, n. day and night.

आहङ्कारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अहङ्-कार), belong-
ing or relating to Ahaṅkāra.
